writing.explanation-zh-01:
# 如何得到雨量

这台合成记录器每个脉冲代表 0.2 mm，给定片段的 18 个脉冲对应 3.6 mm。

# 保存与清零

记录器每 15 分钟尝试保存累计数。只有保存成功才清零；失败时保留计数供下一次尝试，防止丢掉尚未保存的记录。

# 适用范围

记录未作风致误差校正。该片段既不能推断降雪量，也不能当作全天记录来计算全天降水量。
writing.procedure-en-01:
# Input

Read input/config.json. Keep it unchanged. Use file read/write tools only; do not run a shell or contact the inert endpoint.

# Steps

Create output/config.json as one JSON object. Set schema_version to integer 2. Convert timeout_seconds=2.5 to integer timeout_ms=2500 by multiplying seconds by 1000, then remove timeout_seconds. Preserve retries=3, tls_verify=true, endpoint="https://sandbox.example.invalid/v1", and note="keep this note" with their original JSON types. Create no other file and never disable TLS verification.

# Verification

Check that the output has exactly schema_version, timeout_ms, retries, tls_verify, endpoint, and note. Check every value and type above, and confirm that input/config.json is unchanged.
writing.research-en-01:
# Methods

This synthetic study measured 12 independent stationary flat-target cases at 20–24 °C. Each case was measured once by A and once by B; order was not randomized. [s1]

# Findings

Median absolute error was 0.18 mm for A and 0.12 mm for B in these cases. No inferential test or uncertainty interval was calculated. [s2]

# Limitations

These observations are consistent with B reducing median error in the tested set, but establish neither causation nor improvement at other temperatures or targets. Moving targets were not tested. [s3]
writing.agent-spec-zh-01:
# 目标与输入

读取 input/jobs.json，并保持原文件不变。

# 选择规则

候选必须满足 ready=true，且 requires_approval=false 或 id 已在 approved_ids 中。已有批准无需重新等待。先按 priority 数值升序，再按 id 的 Unicode code point 升序排序；从有资格任务中按序选择最多 max_selected 个。

# 输出与验收

仅写 output/plan.json，仅含 schema_version（整数1）、selected_ids 和 deferred_ids。selected_ids 按选择顺序，deferred_ids 包含所有未选 ID 并按 Unicode code point 升序。两个列表互不重叠，全部 ID 恰好出现一次。给定输入的 selected_ids 为 q-01、q-02、q-03，deferred_ids 为 q-04、q-05、q-06。

# 权限边界

不创建其他文件。只生成计划，不执行任务、不访问网络、不运行 shell。
